dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And how would you differentiate them?

dialogues.speaker: Herbier
dialogues.text: Well, we'd need to analyze each case in detail, but I do have a personal "prescription."

dialogues.speaker: Herbier
dialogues.text: If Lady Furina comes personally and looks excited, then the case itself might not be important, but there must be something incredible about it all the same.

dialogues.speaker: Herbier
dialogues.text: ...Though even if there is no such thing, she will whip up drama of her own accord.

dialogues.speaker: Herbier
dialogues.text: And if the Chief Justice personally presides over the trial, then it's almost certainly worth paying attention — it will certainly be more newsworthy, that's for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Herbier
dialogues.text: But such cases aren't very easy to report on. In fact, some of them involve information blackouts.
